snippet.title: Cosmo Vulpes - SAGExpo 25 Teaser
snippet.description:
After one year out, Cosmo Vulpes is back to SAGE!

Try this new demo at the event! With a revamped Green Ruins map! There is new gadgets, new enemies, more movement options, and even more collectibles to get!
